items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: This was a very fine friend of mine

ctx.x: The L. W. Klein, the Gabriel Company. This was a very fine friend of mine, and a very wealthy man in Indianapolis, Indiana. Mm-hmm. And always, always, every time he came to New Orleans, always had me to his hotel suite, and his wife would love me.
